apply_rope_inplace: apply rotary position embedding inplace to query and key tensors with a cosine-sine cache
apply_rope_inplace_with_kvcache: apply rotary position embedding inplace to query and key tensors and store rotated keys into kv cache
apply_rope_with_cos_sin_cache_inplace: apply rotary position embedding inplace to query and key tensors with optional fused kv cache store
rotary_embedding: apply rotary position embedding to query and key tensors using a precomputed cosine-sine cache
FusedSetKVBufferArg: create a dataclass holding value, key buffer, value buffer, and cache location tensors for fused rope with kv cache store
